examBlueprint.passRequires: Both sections must independently meet their thresholds. Do not use pooled 40-item overall percentage.
examBlueprint.practiceScoringPolicy: For equal-weight in-app items: theory >=20/30 and practical >=6/10. This is the app calculation from published percentages; do not claim unpublished official per-item weights.

items.correction: Figure 9-3 should be 9-2; figure 9-4 should be 9-3
Table 6-13 inorganic insulation examples: mica and ceramic only; remove natural rubber.
Do not universalize K-type thermocouple range -73 to1300C; official revised text states below zero to over1000C. Actual rating depends on instrument and conditions.
Acidic oxide reacts with base to form salt; basic oxide reacts with acid to form salt. Uploaded text reverses the definitions.
Official errata changes phosphorus oxide example to 三酸化リン(P2O3); uploaded name/formula inconsistent. Avoid phosphorus oxide example until independently resolving naming/formula; use CO2/SO2 examples.
Section label (3)特徴 should be (2)特徴.
Anodizing equation must retain oxide-ion 2- charge, including 2Al3+ + 3O2- -> Al2O3. Verify superscripts visually; text extraction loses them.

safetyReviewRules.rule: Never state gloves are required for every task; the source specifically prohibits gloves at drilling-machine rotating tools. Chemical-protective and electrical PPE are task-specific.
Emergency stopping does not establish zero-energy isolation. Do not teach reaching into machinery based solely on pressing stop. Follow local authorized energy-isolation procedure.
No improvised chemical mixing, neutralization, wastewater treatment or dosage instructions. Site-approved procedure/SDS, trained authorization and engineering controls take precedence.
Do not imply theoretical course completion qualifies learner for licensed/live electrical work; avoid universal insulation or meter-use claims.
A textbook figure or worked example is not a universal machine/process operating instruction.
